name: "Snubble special" pistol
description: The "snubble special" pistol, also known as just the "snubble", was a black-colored model of double-snub nosed blaster pistol. The blaster had limited ammunition but packed a powerful punch and included a stun setting. The Grindalid Moloch, a lieutenant of the White Worms gang, favored using a "snubble" that was equipped with a scope with built in luma-compensators. He also removed the stun setting on his pistol to ensure he always used lethal force.
